name: Dates Dry Fruits Punch – 450g
description: Fit Monk Dates Dry Fruits Punch is an artisanal Indian sweet snack crafted from roasted nuts bound together with rich, natural dates. Sliced into ready-to-eat squares in a 450g pack, this date punch offers a firm, chewy texture and nutty flavor without relying on artificial fillers.

faqs.question: What does "punch" mean in this product?
faqs.answer: In Indian confectionery and the Fit Monk catalog, "punch" refers to a solid, sliced sweet block made of roasted nuts bound with fruit paste (dates), not a beverage.

faqs.question: Is there a multi-pack discount?
faqs.answer: Yes, the catalog notes an offer of ₹200 off when ordering two packs.
